results.case: A wallet holding a single token fires the same 1 RBT to many receivers at the same instant - only one may win
results.expected: Exactly one of the concurrent sends is accepted and the rest refused - no double spend
results.actual: no DID on the sender's node holds nothing - a one-token wallet cannot be made without draining, and draining is not reliable
results.note: run once, without delay: time-boxed, so a delayed rerun would spend its window waiting for the fullnode

results.case: Many DIDs on one node, then on one machine, all transfer at once through one quorum - the node and the machine under full concurrent load
results.expected: Record how many concurrent transfers a single node and a single machine sustain with every transfer correct
results.actual: node- and machine-level concurrency measured (quorums sized from QCAP-01)
results.note: node (10 DIDs, one quorum, capacity 220): 10/10 at once, p95 0.2s | machine (38 DIDs on 9 nodes, 1 quorums): 36/38 at once, p95 0.4s - refused: 1x initiateConsensusHandler: transaction info validation failed: ValidateTransaction: failed to get quorum DID for token 60001_100143: tokenID "60001_100143" not f; 1x initiateConsensusHandler: transaction info validation failed: ValidateTransaction: failed to get quorum DID for token 60001_103217: tokenID "60001_103217" not f | run once, without delay: time-boxed, so a delayed rerun would spend its window waiting for the fullnode

results.case: More and more of the fleet transfer at the same instant - 10, 20, up the ladder to every DID that can send
